title: narcissus pseudonarcissus var. minor
intro: Narcissus pseudonarcissus var. minor, commonly known as the wild daffodil, is a perennial plant species that belongs to the Amaryllidaceae family. It is valued for its health benefits, which include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, helping to alleviate symptoms of various conditions such as fever, rheumatism, and respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its ability to exhibit sedative and antispasmodic effects, making it useful in treating anxiety, insomnia, and muscle spasms. The bioactive constituents of Narcissus pseudonarcissus var. minor include alkaloids, flavonoids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties and are being researched for their potential in treating various diseases.
